findings.headline: Unused bookings block equipment for others
findings.evidence: Participants described instruments showing as booked while sitting empty.

quotes.quote: Bookings that nobody shows up for.
So when people don't use their bookings, it's people like me who lose out.
Nobody ever comes to their bookings.

contrasting_views.quote: Experiments run long, things fail, you need some slack.

findings.interpretation: Hoarding may be a response to scarcity.

findings.headline: Recurring maintenance windows are highly valued
findings.evidence: One participant called recurring maintenance their favourite feature.

quotes.quote: That's my favourite feature by a mile.

findings.interpretation: Facility staff may value automation of routine blocks.
